parameters.query:
SELECT ci.*, cp.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.selling_points
FROM content_items ci
JOIN content_plans cp ON ci.plan_id = cp.id
JOIN products p ON cp.product_id = p.id
WHERE cp.user_id = $1
  AND ci.row_number = $2
ORDER BY cp.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1
